nothing created by cancel

result: 'Tamamlandı' and the receipt is shown

the version folder holds ONLY artifact.bin (no sidecar / notice file)
no file outside the manager folder and the database was created

audit chain still verifies after the whole sequence

result: removal 'Tamamlandı'

status is 'Kaldırıldı'
reinstall through the same preview and confirmation
